messages:
jordan: Quick sanity check — can someone run a fast H100 vs A100 vs L40S smoke for 2k/8k context throughput + peak GPU mem? need rough numbers for Fri demo.

maria: Happy to do A100 and L40S in eu-west. Which model & batch/seq settings?

jordan: Thanks — use rwd/gpt-4-small-8k (the inference-optimized variant). run: batch=1, seq=2048 (2k) and seq=8192 (8k). please include p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and peak memory.

kevin: I can run H100 in us-west tonight. tagging the PR that changed nv kernel selection: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1327 — should we include a run with kernel-selector=experimental?

anya: I can spin up L40S in gcp europe and run 2k + 8k. will need the exact bench command.

maria: use this command:
```
./perf_bench --model rwd/gpt-4-small-8k --devices $DEVICE --batch 1 --seq $SEQLEN --threads 8 --profile kernels,mem --out /tmp/$DEVICE-$SEQLEN.json
```
replace $DEVICE with a100,h100,l40s and SEQLEN with 2048 or 8192.

kevin: copying that. will run with kernel-selector=stable and =experimental (two runs). leaving traces in s3://redwood-perf/sanity/1779954321/kevin/

ci-bot: perf-run queued by kevin (job id perf-8892). ETA ~45m.

kevin: quick heads-up — experimental kernel crashed on h100 for 8k (oom) but stable completed. posting numbers in a sec.

maria: noted. i'll start a100+l40s now. will also attach nvprof traces.

kevin: H100 stable (8k): p50=74ms, p95=148ms, tokens/sec=85, peak_mem=28.3GB. 2k run: p50=21ms, p95=42ms, tokens/sec=300, peak_mem=20.1GB. (batch=1)

kevin: small snippet of run output:
```
[INFO] seq=8192, steps=125, avg_tokens/sec=85.2
[KERNEL] matmul-ff: 42%
[MEM] peak=28.3GB
```

maria: A100 results (8k): p50=95ms, p95=210ms, tokens/sec=60, peak_mem=31.7GB. L40S (8k): p50=110ms, p95=240ms, tokens/sec=52, peak_mem=30.2GB. 2k numbers: A100 tokens/sec=220, L40S tokens/sec=180.

anya: L40S kernel traces show higher memcpy time on large sequences, probably PCIe/host traffic differences. attaching short flame graph to s3://redwood-perf/sanity/1779954321/anya/l40s-flame.svg

jordan: awesome — very helpful. can someone paste a single CSV line per run (device,seq,p50,p95,tokens/sec,peak_mem,kernel-mode) so I can drop into the demo slide quickly?

kevin: h100,8192,74,148,85,28.3,stable

maria: a100,8192,95,210,60,31.7,stable

anya: l40s,8192,110,240,52,30.2,stable

jordan: thanks. kevin — can you open a small follow-up PR to add the perf command to our infra repo and mention the experimental kernel crash? just a one-liner doc + issue link. ping me for review.

kevin: will do, linking PR when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/459

maria: small ask — can we also capture p99 in next runs? might be relevant for tail latency slides.

kevin: sure, i'll add p99 and re-run 2k tonight.

jordan: perfect. will update the slide deck with these numbers and s3 links. tagging @maria @kevin for followups — thanks all :tada:
